title: Will there be a white person on the winning team?

rules: YES if at least one listed member of an overall winning team voluntarily and explicitly self-identifies as white. title: Will there be a reported goose attack?
shortTitle: Will there be a reported goose attack?
description: Will there be a reported goose attack?
rules: Resolves YES if at least one verified goose attack involving a Hack the North attendee occurs on the University of Waterloo campus before market close. A qualifying attack includes a goose chasing, pecking, biting, striking, or otherwise making physical contact with a person. Hissing, staring menacingly, blocking a sidewalk, or simply being a Waterloo goose does not count. Evidence must include the approximate time and location plus either photo/video evidence or two independent firsthand accounts. Multiple reports of the same encounter count as one incident. Incidents caused by deliberate provocation, feeding, handling, or staging do not count. Do not approach or provoke wildlife.

title: Will a GPT wrapper win?
description: Will a GPT wrapper win at Hack the North 2026?
rules: Resolves YES if a Hack the North 2026 winner is primarily a thin interface or workflow built around GPT, where calling an existing GPT model/API provides the project’s core functionality. Simply using GPT somewhere in a project does not make it a GPT wrapper. Projects with substantial original systems, hardware, infrastructure, models, algorithms, or other functionality beyond wrapping the model do not automatically qualify. Goosey moderators determine whether a finalist qualifies based on its submitted project, demo, and publicly presented implementation.
resolutionSource: Official Hack the North finalist and winner announcements, submitted projects, demos, and publicly presented implementations.
pricingRationale: Neutral starting price; not an evidence-based forecast.
